mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sd_user su ORDER BY su.user_id ASC
mapper.insert: insert into sd_user_management_log ( admin_user_id, target_user_id, type_id, description ) values ( #{adminUserId}, #{targetUserId}, #{typeId}, #{description} )
mapper.select: SELECT uml.log_id AS logId, uml.admin_user_id AS adminUserId, uml.target_user_id AS targetUserId, uml.type_id AS typeId, uml.description AS description, uml.created_at AS createdAt, admin_user.username AS adminUsername, target_user.username AS targetUsername, umt.type_name AS typeName FROM sd_user_management_log uml LEFT JOIN sd_user admin_user ON uml.admin_user_id = admin_user.user_id LEFT JOIN sd_user target_user ON uml.target_user_id = target_user.user_id LEFT JOIN sd_user_management_type umt ON uml.type_id = umt.type_id ORDER BY uml.log_id DESC
